note: This is a field specification, not a one-click JotForm import file -- JotForm doesn't support importing a form from a plain JSON file. Recreate these fields in JotForm's drag-and-drop Form Builder (about 3 minutes), matching the field names below exactly, then wire the form's Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks to this workflow's 'When Lead Form Is Submitted' Production URL. The same field list works in Typeform, Fluent Forms, or any form tool that can POST to a webhook.
